spots.name: Amon Carter Museum of American Art
spots.blurb: Free museum of American art; open Tue–Sat 10–5 (Thu to 8), Sun noon–5.
spots.blurbEs: Museo gratuito de arte estadounidense; abre de martes a sábado de 10 a 5 (jueves hasta las 8) y domingo de 12 a 5.

spots.name: Fort Worth Stockyards
spots.blurb: Historic Stockyards with the Fort Worth Herd's longhorn cattle drive daily at 11:30 a.m. and 4 p.m.
spots.blurbEs: Los históricos Stockyards, con el arreo de longhorns de la Fort Worth Herd todos los días a las 11:30 a.m. y 4 p.m.
